owa.config.title: Old Walking Animation
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.enabl: Turns the mod on or off

Enables or disables most of the features for mobs
§7§oDamage and Death settings are unaffected
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.bodyR: Makes the body rotate similarly to how it dose in the survival test versions of the game
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.bounc: Makes mobs/players bounce up and down when walking/running

Flips the bounce out of phase with the limb swing.
Off: feet are straight down at the bottom of the bounce.
On: feet are swung out at the bottom of the bounce (classic c0.0.23a-style look).
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.speed:
Changes how fast the bouncing and arm & leg animation plays
§7§oIf Use Vanilla speed is enabled then this setting will do nothing
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.maxSp:
Caps how fast the animation can play regardless of movement speed.
§7§oSet to 1.0 to disable the cap.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.speed: Minimum movement speed before the animation starts playing.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.vanil:
This makes the arm & leg swing/bounce use the vanilla speed
§7§oThis setting will disable the speed and max speed sliders
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.speed: When on, movement speed scales the arm & leg swing amount.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.smoot: Smoothly transitions the animation between moving and still states.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.decay: How quickly the smoothing responds. Higher values snap faster.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.damag: Replaces the vanilla hit wobble with the classic spin-and-lean death/damage animation.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.veloc: Derives the damage lean angle from the attacker's direction instead of the fixed classic source angle.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.fallb: If the velocity source can't be determined, fall back to the fixed classic lean angle.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.damag: How far the entity leans over on damage. 14 matches classic.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.lockR: Freezes the damage lean angle until the animation ends, preventing mid-animation jitter.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.damag: Tints the entity with a custom color when hurt instead of the vanilla red flash.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.enabl: Replaces the vanilla first-person arm position/rotation with the custom values below.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.Ytran: Vertical offset of the first-person arm.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.Xtran: Horizontal offset of the first-person arm.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.Ztran: Depth offset of the first-person arm.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.Pitch: Pitch rotation of the first-person arm.
Roll rotation of the first-person arm.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.Yaw.t: Yaw rotation of the first-person arm.
Swings the arms in the classic flailing pattern while walking.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.ridin: Keeps the arm and leg animation playing when the player is riding a mob.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.class: Plays the walking animation continuously, even while standing still.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.tpose: Holds the arms straight out to the sides when idle.
How far the arms are held out in the T-pose.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.sneak: Uses the pre-1.8 sneaking arm pose instead of the modern one.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.headB: Bobs the head side-to-side and up-and-down while moving.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.headS: How fast the head bobs while walking.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.headA: How far the head bobs while walking.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.enabl: Press the keybind to spawn a Classic Human that wanders around. Client-side only — invisible to the server.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.maxHu: Upper limit on how many Classic Humans can exist at once. 0 = unlimited.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.natur: Spawns Classic Humans from the sky when chunks load, like old Minecraft versions did on world load.

Chance that a loaded chunk will spawn a Classic Human.
40% matches the original ~100 humans per small indev world (100 / 256 chunks).
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.authe:
When on: 1-to-1 pre-Classic Zombie physics (jump 0.5, ground accel 0.1, jump chance 0.08, ground friction *0.7).
When off: gentler modern-feel physics (jump 0.42, ground accel 0.02, jump chance 0.04, ground friction *0.8).
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.rdEar:
Uses the earliest Zombie physics (rd-132328): gravity 0.005, jump 0.12, ground accel 0.02, jump chance 0.01, friction *0.8.
Floaty, slow, original pre-Classic feel.
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.steve: Makes Classic Humans use the classic old-animation preset regardless of your current settings
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.rdHea:
On: Classic Humans bob their heads in the rd-20090515 style.
Off: no head bob (matches c0.0.15a and c0.0.23a).
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.rdSty:
On: sine-based limbs — legs point straight down at the bottom of the bounce (rd-20090515 / c0.0.15a).
Off: cosine-based limbs — legs swung out at the bottom of the bounce (c0.0.23a).

Combine with Head Bob to get three real presets:
- Head Bob ON + Limbs ON = rd-20090515
- Head Bob OFF + Limbs ON = c0.0.15a
- Head Bob OFF + Limbs OFF = c0.0.23a
oldwalkinganimation.midnightconfig.steve:
Draws a name label above each Classic Human.
Name source:
- Default skins: skin name (Steve, Alex, Zuri, ...)
- Your Skin / Random Seen Player: the real player name
- Classic Steve: "Steve"
- Custom Skin: "Custom"
Comma-separated list of Minecraft player names or skin URLs.

Which skin to use for spawned Classic Humans.
- Random Default: random stock skin per Human
- Classic Steve: the original pre-2022 Steve skin (drop PNG at assets/oldwalkinganimation/textures/entity/classic_steve.png)
- Your Skin: uses the skin you're wearing
- Random Seen Player: random skin of a player you've seen on a server
- Custom Skin: enter player names or skin URLs in the Custom Skins box, comma-separated. Each Steve picks one. Falls back to a single PNG at config/oldwalkinganimation-custom-skin.png if the box is empty.
